instruction: Load /usr/share/sounds/alsa/Front_Center.wav onto Deck 1 and play it for at least 2 seconds

verification.condition: Deck 1 title text contains "Front_Center" and Deck 1 elapsed time counter is >= 00:02 while the deck is in playing state
verification.expected_result: The sample file "Front_Center" is playing on Deck 1 for at least 2 seconds
